claims.text: On a standalone basis, Cera's main business activity is manufacturing and trading of sanitaryware, faucetsware, tiles, bathroom accessories and allied products, which is stated as 100% of turnover.
Standalone turnover mix per the FY2023-24 annual report: sanitaryware 47%, faucetsware 36%, bathroom accessories and allied products 7%, and trading of tiles 10%.
On a standalone basis the entity has 2 plants and 33 offices (including depots) in India, and serves 28 States and 08 Union Territories.

In the Q3 & 9M FY2024-25 call, Vikas Kothari said management is optimistic and committed to the Rs. 2,900 crore target by March 2027, supported by a strong project pipeline. He said that if retail growth improves they are confident of meeting growth targets, with the caveat that this is contingent on the market recovering as expected.
claims.speaker: Vikas Kothari

claims.text: In the Q3 & 9M FY2024-25 call, Vikas Kothari said average price increases were 6% in Faucetware and 1% in Sanitaryware. He said effective price realization in Q3 was approximately 2% and the remaining 4% growth was volume-driven, because project orders often have pre-agreed pricing.
claims.speaker: Vikas Kothari

claims.text: In the Q3 & 9M FY2024-25 call, Deepak Chaudhary said that although early signs of demand improvement were seen, market conditions remained challenging and demand did not pick up as expected. He cited revenue growth from Rs. 437 crore to Rs. 449 crore.
claims.speaker: Deepak Chaudhary

claims.text: In the earlier Q2 FY2024-25 call, Deepak Chaudhary said sanitaryware and faucetware accounted for 46% and 41% of total revenues respectively. He said a price adjustment in September 2024 (6% for faucets, 1% for sanitaryware) followed an 18% rise in brass prices between March and June.
claims.speaker: Deepak Chaudhary
